marta_cs: FYI Acme Shipping (contact: eileen@acmeship) wants to onboard a bespoke manifest summarizer model. They want Private deployment + HSM, strict PII redaction, and a latency target ~<=300ms tail for live queries. Asking for eval plan + renewal impact. Can someone pick this up?
sam_se: I can take SE lead. Do we have the artifact format? Marta, any idea on model size?
marta_cs: Eileen says PyTorch 2.0, ~6B fine-tuned on manifests. They can share artifacts and sample data but want an NDA addendum for logs.
devon_safety: Clarifying Qs: what PII types exactly? Any PHI? Will logs ever leave the customer's VPC? We'll need an eval suite focusing on redaction, extraction probes, and adversarial prompts.
marta_cs: Eileen: "no PHI, mostly names, postal addresses, shipment IDs, some customs identifiers." They request that we avoid persistent token storage and keep KV cache ephemeral. Also asks about SOC2 + KMS/HSM proof.
sam_se: Sounds doable. Recommend Redwood Private with HSM + audit logs. For latency we should run a perf profile; likely route to a Dedicated low-latency pool and apply int8 quantization. I'll schedule a perf/eval run. @irene_pm can we fast-track product sign-off for the dedicated config?
irene_pm: We'll need product + infra sign-off on the Dedicated sizing and SLA. Also flag renewal risk: if they require reserved capacity this becomes a commercial discussion (monthly/annual commit). Put this in CRM.
devon_safety: Eval checklist (high level): 1) anonymized sample manifests, 2) redaction probe set, 3) PII extraction adversarial set, 4) hallucination QA prompts. Need samples by EOD Mon to meet SLA. We'll measure false redaction rate and high-severity exposures.
ops_bot: deploy-bot: created ticket CI-7984 for "acme manifest redaction/eval". https://redwood.atlassian.io/browse/CI-7984 :white_check_mark:
sam_se: Quick operational Q: can they provide ~500 representative rows + schema? Also recommend running a canary on Dedicated with prefix caching disabled to measure tail latency under realistic QPS.
marta_cs: I'll request samples and schema now. Scheduling enablement + infra sync for next Wed 10am PT with Eileen + their infra lead. Also suggest a post-onboard QBR to discuss reserved capacity and renewal timing — their usage today is low on hosted.
devon_safety: Example eval command for SEs once samples arrive:
```
python eval_suite.py --model artifact.pt --data samples.jsonl --safety redaction,pii-probe --output results.json
```
Run with `--record-audit` to capture logs into the HSM-backed audit bucket.
sam_se: Got it — I'll prep the perf harness and share results here. ETA 48-72hrs after samples land. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
marta_cs: tagging @ben_sales for renewal awareness — potential committed deal if they require Dedicated/HSM.
ben_sales: Noted, thanks. I'll join the QBR and start drafting pricing tiers for reserved capacity + HSM surcharge.
marta_cs: Great, thanks everyone. I'll update CI-7984 with samples when Eileen sends them and close loop on NDA addendum. :thumbsup:
